messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime-p99-latency spike detected on hosted inference cluster eu-west-1 (rule: realtime-latency-p99 > 1200ms). Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/sLO/realtime-latency
elena: acknowledged, I'm oncall. Paging SRE rotation now.
elena: quick ask — is this from a single model or cross-model? any recent rollouts?
sam: looking — p95 ~ 420ms -> 730ms, p99 jumped from 900ms -> 1800ms over last 6m. Spike aligns with sustained streaming requests. breakdown by route: chat-streaming up 3x latency, batch endpoints fine.
ryan: checking infra — no obvious node restarts in the last hour. autoscaler not triggering. kubectl top shows some pods at 95% CPU.
ryan: kubectl get pods -n inference | grep eu-west | awk '{print $1" "$3" "$4""}'
ryan: (snippet)
  inf-svc-7f9d   Running   3/3
  inf-svc-8a1c   Running   3/3
sam: sampling traces -> high queue_wait and heavy KV-cache eviction events. trace: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/trace/0f1a2b
opsbot: PagerDuty alert created: PD-INC-12421 (paged: @sre-rotation).
sre-rotation: on it. first pass checks: (1) check model-side stalls (2) check proxy/backpressure (3) check streaming buffer fill.
product-ops: any sign of customer-facing errors or only latency? Need impact summary for any active pages.
elsa: hey — small note: product-ops name should be product-ops, i'm prod.
elena: product-ops, early read: error rate is normal (~0.1%), but client-side timeouts increased for some streaming routes. No full 5xx spike yet.
sam: digging by version: traffic to model variant q8_1 has p99 2.1s, q4v3 is stable at 650ms. Recent traffic shift: q8_1 received 18% more requests last 10m (likely due to routing experiment).
ryan: running quick log search for streaming stalls:
```
grep -i "stream stall" /var/log/inference/* | tail -n 50
2026-03-15T14:02:33Z inf-svc-7f9d ERROR stream stall seq=1423 shard=2 wait=1201ms
2026-03-15T14:03:09Z inf-svc-8a1c WARN kvcache evict keys=12000 pressure=0.82
```
ryan: kvcache pressure looks high on nodes serving q8_1. evictions correlate with p99 spikes.
sre-rotation: mitigation idea: route a portion of q8_1 traffic to q4v3 or enable prefix caching for long chats. can try doubling kvcache size on a couple hot pods to validate.
elena: agree. do smaller blast radius: shift 15% of q8_1 to q4v3 in eu-west. opsbot, can you open a routing rollback ticket?
opsbot: Routing change request created: RC-4312. Scheduled immediate canary: 15% traffic to q4v3 for 5 minutes.
product-ops: flagging top 3 customers on streaming (ids masked): cust-a (heavy), cust-b (moderate), cust-c (low). I'll notify CS for cust-a.
sam: applied Grafana zoom -> after canary started (t+2m) p99 on eu-west dropped from 1.8s -> 980ms; p95 moved from 730ms -> 500ms.
ryan: scaling test — kubectl scale deployment inf-svc --replicas=6 -n inference (in case CPU is bottleneck). Monitoring pods spin up.
ryan: also ran a hot-patch: increased KV_CACHE_SIZE env on two hot pods and restarted them, new pods show lower eviction rate.
sre-rotation: early takeaway: primary driver appears to be KV cache pressure on q8_1 variant under streaming patterns (long-lived KV growth causing stalls). routing to q4v3 reduces tail.
elena: good. next immediate action: maintain canary at 15% for 10m, continue autoscale to 6 replicas, monitor p99 and stream stall logs. If p99 stays <1s we'll consider progressive rollout of routing change.
product-ops: customer impact note: cust-a reported increased streaming lag (timeouts) but no content loss. CS notified and standby for updates.
sam: adding an alert refinement: reduce alert noise by adding a short 2m suppression window for this rule to avoid flapping during mitigation. PR: https://github.com/redwood/alerts/pull/987
opsbot: Zoom incident bridge started: zoom.meet/redwood-inc/6623456789 (host: elena).
sre-rotation: posting checklist:
- preserve debug logs for affected pods (done)
- collect heap snapshots if KV pressure persists
- evaluate model routing experiment rollback (if routing is root cause)
- plan follow-up work: KV eviction tuning, streaming buffer metrics
elena: callout for post-mortem: track the experiment that increased q8_1 traffic — was it a failed rollout? Sam, can you capture exact traffic shift time and correlation?
sam: will capture. preliminary shows shift started at 14:00:53 UTC when traffic splitter config pushed by release pipeline RC-4301.
ryan: if KV pressure recurs we can consider changing eviction policy from LRU->LIRS on affected nodes, but need bench tests.
elena: thanks all. current status: canary holding, p99 trending down but not fully back to baseline. continuing live watch. if p99 > 1.5s again we escalate to page infra-eng leadership.
product-ops: I'll update CS and standby. prepare notes for post-incident timeline.
incident-bot: UPDATE: Alert suppressed (auto) after canary reduced p99 below threshold. PD-INC-12421 resolved (monitoring).
elena: closing live mitigation loop for now — we'll keep incident open for postmortem. convene async triage in #incidents-ops in 1h. :white_check_mark:
